t: WHYY acquires local news site Billy Penn - WHYY
s: April 15, 2019 - The company serves the Philadelphia region, including the city and suburbs, South Jersey, Delaware, and Pennsylvania. It launched its own digital news product, “Newsworks,” in 2010, focusing on hyperlocal news. The company dropped that moniker during a website redesign in 2017. WHYY’s evolving digital-first presence includes the 2015 purchase of PlanPhilly, a website devoted to transportation, housing, and other urban issues. Acquiring Billy Penn “with its punchy, engaging brand fortifies our already thriving collaborative newsroom,” said Sandra Clark, WHYY’s Vice President for News and Civic Dialogue, in a statement.
